items.title: Samsung launches Galaxy Buds On, its first clip-on open-ear earbuds
items.summary: Unveiled on October 1, 2026, the Galaxy Buds On are Samsung's first clip-on, open-ear wireless earbuds, keeping the ear canal open for situational awareness. They feature TwinBoost speakers, Audio Leakage Reduction, three-mic Intelligent Clear Call, Gemini Live and head-gesture controls, with up to 9.5 hours of playback.

items.title: Fairphone sets October 14 launch for Fairbuds 2 with modular repair and LDAC
items.summary: Fairphone will reveal the Fairbuds 2 on October 14, 2026, retaining seven fully replaceable modular parts for easy repair. The second-generation earbuds add Sony LDAC hi-res codec support alongside SBC and AAC, and launch at a competitive 119 euros in Europe and 119 US dollars.

items.title: Shokz brings OpenDots 2 open-ear earbuds to the Philippines
items.summary: Shokz has launched the OpenDots 2 clip-on open-ear earbuds in the Philippines, featuring Bassphere 2.0, upgraded Dolby Audio and DirectPitch leakage reduction. The buds offer triple AI noise-canceling mics, IP57 rating, Bluetooth 6.1 and up to 40 hours of total battery life, priced at PHP 12,990.

items.title: AirPods Pro 3 review: stronger ANC, better fit, battery and heart-rate sensing
items.summary: The AirPods Pro 3 improve active noise cancellation, fit and individual-bud battery life over the previous generation, adding workout heart-rate sensing and Live Translation. Reviewers note they are among the strongest true-wireless earbuds for iPhone owners, though Android users lose much of the ecosystem value.

items.title: Shokz OpenDots 2 reviewed: the comfiest earbuds I have worn all day
items.summary: After weeks of testing across commutes, walks and the gym, the Shokz OpenDots 2 clip-on open-ear earbuds impressed with lightweight comfort, 40-hour battery life and discreet sound leakage. The writer recommends them as an open-ear option that stays secure without aching the ears, especially on sale during Prime events.

items.title: Bose launches Ultra Open Earbuds (2nd Gen) and Sport Open Earbuds
items.summary: Bose unveiled two clip-style open-ear models on September 17, 2026: the flagship Ultra Open Earbuds (2nd Gen) with deeper bass, Cinema Mode and 9 hours of battery, and the cheaper Sport Open Earbuds built for workouts. Both keep the cuff design with an open ear canal and no active noise cancellation, launching October 1.

items.title: Omdia: TWS shipments slip as open-ear (OWS) earbuds surge 12%
items.summary: Omdia's Q2 2026 data shows global true wireless stereo shipments fell 0.7 percent year over year to 82.1 million units, the first decline in 13 quarters. Open wireless stereo (OWS) grew 12 percent to 11.1 million units, with Shokz leading at 10.3 percent share and 107.9 percent growth; Omdia forecasts OWS to reach 90.5 million units by 2030.

items.title: AirPods Pro 3 vs Galaxy Buds 3 Pro: which flagship earbuds to buy
items.summary: A head-to-head comparison finds the AirPods Pro 3 the pick for iPhone owners thanks to heart-rate sensing and hearing-aid features, while the Galaxy Buds 3 Pro suit Samsung users with Live Translation and a two-year warranty. Both lose about a third of their features on the rival platform, so the phone in your pocket decides the winner.

items.title: Best open-ear earbuds to grab in the October Prime Day sale
items.summary: A year of open-earbud testing highlights top picks on sale during October Prime events, including the Bose Ultra Open at 179 US dollars, the Beyerdynamic Amiron ZERO, SoundPEATS UU2 and the EarFun Clip 2 with real-time AI translation. The roundup reflects open-ear audio moving from niche sport gear into mainstream everyday use.

items.title: Best open-ear earbuds of 2026: 7 clip-on picks that keep you aware
items.summary: A 2026 buying guide ranks the best clip-on open-ear earbuds, citing the Huawei FreeClip 2 as best overall, the Sony LinkBuds Clip for iPhone users, and Bose's new Ultra Open Earbuds (2nd Gen) for sound and features. It notes the open-ear category has matured into a viable alternative for all-day listeners who dislike sealed in-ear tips.
